title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-23
lineage: Sbd Mcassette > DAT > CDR> CDR > EAC (secure mode) > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Greek Theatre show with scorching Scarlet > Fire, epic Estimated > Eyes jams and a solid soundboard mix that puts Bob’s guitar front‑and‑center.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its intensity – a blazing Shakedown opener, a marathon Scarlet > Fire, and lengthy Estimated > Eyes/Other One sequences that keep the energy soaring.  The soundboard recording is generally clear and enjoyable, though Bob Weir’s guitar sits high in the mix and a few balance tweaks are noted.  Overall fans consider it one of the standout Greek Theatre dates of ’82.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.63; comments overwhelmingly praise the musical performance (high‑energy, long jams) and note a good but not flawless soundboard mix.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and crisp; occasional mix quirks such as Bob Weir’s guitar being very forward and a few spots that could use better level balancing, but no major drop‑outs or distortion.

poor_songs: Shakedown (first‑set vocal start) – noted as weak by one reviewer
show_quality.setlist_flow: A punchy Shakedown opener leads into a tight first set, followed by an epic second set with a 33‑minute Scarlet > Fire and marathon Estimated/Eyes/Other One jams, capped by a double encore of Satisfaction and Brokedown Palace.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals start thin on Shakedown but quickly recover; leads are purposeful and deliver strong guitar work throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: His guitar is prominently placed in the mix, delivering compelling rhythm and melodic lines—especially funky on Shakedown and driving the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s organ/keyboard textures are highlighted as adventurous and energetic, adding depth to jams like Estimated > Eyes.
band_member_comments.Drums: The dual drummers lock in tightly; drum solo described as a ‘pound‑fest’ that drives the set forward.
